biography.value:
Description

This dragon's scales are the color of ocean's waves, this young adult, serpentine dragon moves with the waves themselves. Blue dragons are usually found by large bodies of water.

Defense

AC 29, touch 12, flat-footed 25 (+4 dex, +17 natural, -2 size)

hp 184 [272] (16d12+80)

mp 105

Fort +16, Ref +16, Will +17

DR 10/magic;

Immune Water, Paralysis, Sleep;

Resist Fire 50%;

SR 24;

Weakness Lightning

Offense

Speed 60 ft., swim 90 ft.

Melee Bite +22 (2d8+10 plus 1d6 water damage), 2 Claws +22 (2d6+7), Gore +21 (1d8+10), Tail Slap +19 (2d6+10)

Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft. (15 ft. with bite & gore)

Special Attacks Breath Weapon (100-ft. line, 10d10 water damage, Reflex DC 22 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Crush (Small creatures, DC 22, 2d8+10), Hydrotwister

Special Abilities Dragon Force, Life Sounding, Spring Water

Spells Known (FC CL 16th, Concentration +23)

At will - detect magic, mending, message, read magic, water orb

1st (DC 18) - engulf, water, water blast

2nd (DC 19) - elemental resistance, engulf II, water II

3rd (DC 20) - engulf III, dispel, water III, watera, water breathing, water walk

4th (DC 21) - hydraulic torrent, water IV

5th (DC 22) - drown, geyser, waterga

Statistics

Str 25, Dex 18, Con 21, Int 14, Wis 24, Cha 16

Base Atk +16; CMB +25; CMD 39 (43 vs. trip)

Feats Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Lunge, Multiattack, Power Attack, Weapon Focus (Bite & Claw)

Skills Diplomacy +21, Knowledge (arcana) +20, Perception +25, Sense Motive +25, Spellcraft +20, Stealth +14, Survival +25, Swim +35; Racial Modifiers +8 Swim

Languages Aquan, Common, Draconic

SQ Unfettered swimmer, water breathing

description.value: A blue dragon releases the dragon soul within, improving itself or an ally by touch. This ability grants the subject an increase to all physical damage, melee and range, by +1 per three caster levels. It also grants the subject an increase to all magical damage and healing by +1 per three caster levels. This ability lasts for a minute. Blue mages may learn this ability as an 8th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 31).

description.value: As a standard action, a blue dragon may emit a refreshing hum that closes the wounds of its fellows. All allies within a 30 ft. radius are healed for 3d6 points of damage, are cured of the Poison status effect, and no longer suffer fatigue. Exhausted allies within the radius are instead fatigued. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd-level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).
